name: DeepMind Lab
description: A 3D first-person reinforcement learning environment built on the DeepMind Lab engine, used to evaluate agents on navigation, memory, and task completion in visually rich worlds.
evaluation_method: Task-specific success rate, cumulative reward, episode completion metrics, and sometimes average return over multiple environment seeds.
notes: Used for embodied RL and partial observability research. Benchmarks often vary by task suite and reward shaping.
